method.where: k8s Job inside the EKS cluster, against the fern-bench Deployment
method.bank: simulated (in-process, Column-like contract); the Column sandbox is not load tested
method.database: its own RDS Postgres 16, db.m7g.2xlarge (8 vCPU) Multi-AZ, like live
method.note: Large run (make bench-up, BENCH_SIZE=large): its own RDS db.m7g.2xlarge Multi-AZ, 12 API pods (1 CPU each) on 2 c7g.4xlarge nodes, build ac397d2 (traces stored by group commit). Every stage met p95 <= 500 ms with no errors: 1,143 req/s at p95 57 ms with 600 VUs, 1,325 req/s at p95 271 ms with 800 VUs. RDS CPU peaked around 57%, so the database was not the limit at 800 VUs; the rise in latency points at the API processes (11 of 12 pods landed on one node), not measured directly. Against the small run (165 req/s on db.t4g.micro) both the database class and trace batching changed, so the gain is not split between them.
